picks.name: 100% Merino V Neck Cardigan, navy
picks.why: Your office and date-night outfits still have no knit or cardigan, and this fills both. A plain regular-fit cardigan in fine-gauge merino with a ribbed hem that sits flat, so it stays neat at the waist and layers under the Ashby or Parachute jacket. Wear it open over a charcoal tee with the fawn chinos and brown Docs, or with the 502s for a date.

picks.name: T-Shirt, charcoal
picks.why: A plain tee is the base layer for three of your five outfits and you still don't have one on the list. Regular fit in 200g organic cotton with a ribbed neck, made in the UK by the same people as your raglan sweats, so it holds its shape under knits. Charcoal works under the navy cardigan, the olive Ashby or the bottle green sweat, with the 502s and Sambas.
